messages:
elaine: Quick heads-up 1026 pilot planning thread \n
We need a concrete acceptance checklist for partners + lightweight feedback loop so CS can surface blocking asks early.

mike: What are the non-negotiable signals you want us to instrument first? I can add dashboards + an alert.

elaine: Minimal set: engagement (active sessions/week >=3 OR >=2 dev seats), qualitative satisfaction (3-ques survey median >=5/7), infra health (p50 latency within 1.5x baseline, error-rate <2%), and quality guardrails (eval suite delta <= +4% hallucination). Commitment = trial activation or signed MOU.

kai: Survey design: 3 questions, one freeform. Include hidden fields: partner_id + prompt_bucket so we can correlate to evals. Keep language customer-facing. Example: `[{"id":"q1","type":"likert","label":"overall_satisfaction"},...]`

nina: CS ops asks: add a "primary ask" freeform at onboarding and a checkbox for "ask is blocker" so we can prioritize. Weekly digest email to partners + monthly 30m review.

mike: I'll add a `pilot_overview` dashboard card (tokens/sec, median latency, 95th latency, 5xx rate, daily active seats) and wire an alert that sets `pilot_pause_recommended` when latency >2x baseline for 6h or error-rate >8% for 3h.

elaine: Proposed go/no-go rule: partner is "green" if 3/4 signals OK for 2 consecutive weeks AND no unresolved critical issues; program launch (public pilot) requires >=2 green partners with MOUs + onboarding docs complete.

nina: Pause rules: sustained p95 >2x baseline for 12h, error-rate spike >10% for 6h, or drop in median survey score by >=2 points week-over-week -> auto notify stakeholders and pause new invites.

kai: I'll build a console CTA "Quick feedback" that opens survey modal. Also prototype an inline banner for paused partners.

ops-bot: Note: onboarding template v3 will auto-deploy 2026-04-03 09:00 UTC.

elaine: Owners: mike -> dashboard + alerts (due Tue); kai -> CTA + modal copy (due Thu); nina -> onboarding fields + digest cadence (due Fri). I'll draft MOU and the acceptance checklist and route to legal.

mike: On it.

kai: Will mock tomorrow.

nina: Drafting digest now.

elaine: Cool. I'll post an updated checklist in #product tomorrow and schedule a 30m alignment with CS/Eng next week. This thread is canonical for pilot acceptance & pause gates. :thumbsup:
